scientific_question: Across the thirty F-ROSS13 extension materials, what is the highest preregistered wet-state level at which the fixed Reference coarse/refined trajectories remain inside the declared common E0 state domain for both DRYING and NOMINAL forcing?

selection_rule.global_common_level: Highest preregistered Se for which all 60 material-by-forcing cases pass every fixed Reference/common-state validity predicate.
selection_rule.no_interpolation: P2E12 does not infer a continuous boundary between scan levels.
selection_rule.no_material_specific_rescue: The global common level is not replaced by material-specific levels for the main follow-up design.

validity_predicates: Reference solver converged on coarse, half1 and half2 trajectories
integrated mass residual available, finite and <=1e-12 cm for all three trajectories
native balance-rate residual available and finite
candidate arrays have the expected shape and finite values
pressure head remains strictly inside -10000 to -1 cm
water content remains strictly between material theta_r and theta_s

interpretation.role: Domain construction only. P2E12 may define the common Reference/common-state design surface for a later candidate-blind threshold freeze and paired RossFast test.
interpretation.nonclaim: A Reference-valid scan level is not itself RossFast-admissible.

next_if_complete: Freeze a new extension comparison design using only a predeclared globally common Se surface, then construct Reference-only thresholds before any new RossFast extension execution.
